Roll & Slay : Dice Caster

Early Access Game

Get instant access and start playing; get involved with this game as it develops.

Note: Games in Early Access are not complete and may or may not change further. If you are not excited to play this game in its current state, then you should wait to see if the game progresses further in development. Learn more

What the developers have to say:

Why Early Access?

“We are releasing the game in Early Access because the core gameplay is already fully playable, but we still have a significant amount of content and improvements planned.

The game is already available on mobile and includes a complete gameplay loop. For the PC version, our goal is to expand the experience into a much larger and more replayable package with additional systems, content, and long-term progression.

Early Access also allows us to refine balance, pacing, and overall game feel through player feedback, especially in a system where luck plays a major role.”

Approximately how long will this game be in Early Access?

“We expect the game to remain in Early Access for approximately 6 to 12 months, depending on development progress and player feedback.

Our goal is to deliver meaningful updates over time and ensure the full version offers a more complete and polished experience rather than rushing to release.”

How is the full version planned to differ from the Early Access version?

“The full version is planned to offer a significantly larger and more complete experience compared to the current Early Access version.

While the core gameplay loop is already fully playable, several systems, content elements, and progression features are still limited or not yet implemented.

Planned additions include:
- New item and equipment systems to expand build variety and player choices
- Bonus monsters that can appear on each floor to increase run diversity
- A wider range of augments to create more unique and powerful combinations
- Additional difficulty options for players seeking greater challenges
- Ongoing balance updates to refine gameplay, especially around luck-based outcomes
- Further development of the game’s art direction and overall tone based on player feedback

In the Early Access version, some of these systems are simplified or intentionally limited, and the overall content pool is smaller than what is planned for the full release.

Our goal is for the full version to provide a deeper, more varied, and more polished experience with significantly more content, progression depth, and replay value.”

What is the current state of the Early Access version?

“The current Early Access version already includes the full core gameplay loop and is fully playable.

Players can climb the tower, engage in dice-based combat, choose augments, earn runes, and compete on global leaderboards across all platforms.

The game is stable and designed for repeated play, but some content, progression systems, and overall variety are still limited compared to what is planned for the full version.”

Will the game be priced differently during and after Early Access?

“We plan to slightly increase the price after Early Access as more content, progression systems, and features are added to the full version.

Early Access players will be able to experience the game at a lower price while it continues to grow.”

How are you planning on involving the Community in your development process?

“We will actively involve the community through Steam forums, reviews, and our official Discord channel.

Player feedback will play a key role in shaping balance changes, new content, and future updates. We aim to respond to community suggestions and continuously improve the game throughout Early Access.”

About This Game

Climb the tower of a lone wizard in this dark fantasy Yahtzee-inspired roguelike dungeon crawler.

Roll the dice and embrace the chaos. Every battle begins with luck. A perfect roll can turn the tide in your favor, while a bad one can leave you struggling to survive. What matters is how far you can go with the hand you are given.

Climb through the tower, earn runes, and strengthen your wizard as you push toward higher floors. On every floor, choose new augments that can completely change the direction of your run.

Experience the thrill of explosive synergies when luck is on your side, and the tension of barely surviving when it is not. Each run is unpredictable, and every decision can shape your outcome.

AI Generated Content Disclosure

The developers describe how their game uses AI Generated Content like this:

Some visual assets in this game were created or enhanced using generative AI tools during development. These assets were reviewed and refined by the development team before being included in the final product.

The game does not use AI to generate content during gameplay.
